text:
The bowl holds sliced red onion and a few dark olives, probably Kalamata. Using rough visual estimates:

- **Red onion:** about 50 g, roughly half a medium onion, at about 40 kcal per 100 g, so about 20 kcal.
- **Olives:** about 6 olives at 4 g each, so about 24 g, at about 115 kcal per 100 g, so about 28 kcal.

That gives roughly 74 g of food and about 48 kcal. There may also be a little oil, so I rounded the energy up slightly.
